declared.title: When failure fails to be productive: probing the effectiveness of productive failure for learning beyond STEM domains

population: 10th graders in 2 quasi-experimental studies (212 and 152 students) learning social science research methods

findings.text: Students who tried a problem before instruction did not learn social science methods better than students taught first

support.sentence: Thus, the findings did not replicate the PF effect on learning in a non-STEM domain.

limits: quasi-experimental: classes, not individuals, were probably assigned
one domain (research methods), one age group; country not given in the abstract
a null result in 2 studies does not show the method harms
